```yaml
name: MkDocs Material Docs Deployment

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install mkdocs-material

      - name: Configure MkDocs
        run: |
          echo "site_name: Airecon" > docs/mkdocs.yml
          echo "theme:" >> docs/mkdocs.yml
          echo "  name: material" >> docs/mkdocs.yml
          echo "  palette:" >> docs/mkdocs.yml
          echo "    primary: indigo" >> docs/mkdocs.yml
          echo "    accent: deep-orange" >> docs/mkdocs.yml
          echo "  features:" >> docs/mkdocs.yml
          echo "    - navigation.tabs" >> docs/mkdocs.yml
          echo "    - search.highlight" >> docs/mkdocs.yml
          echo "    - toc.integrate" >> docs/mkdocs.yml
          echo "    - header.autohide" >> docs/mkdocs.yml
          echo "    - tabs.sticky" >> docs/mkdocs.yml
          echo "    - tabs.iconified" >> docs/mkdocs.yml
          echo "extra_css:" >> docs/mkdocs.yml
          echo "  - assets/custom.css" >> docs/mkdocs.yml

      - name: Create documentation structure
        run: |
          mkdir -p docs/{assets,changelog}
          echo "# Welcome to Airecon" > docs/index.md
          echo "This is the home page of Airecon." >> docs/index.md
          echo "[[TOC]]" >> docs/index.md
          echo "## Features" >> docs/index.md
          echo "Airecon offers the following features:" >> docs/index.md
          echo "- Feature 1" >> docs/index.md
          echo "- Feature 2" >> docs/index.md
          echo "- Feature 3" >> docs/index.md
          echo "## Changelog" >> docs/changelog.md
          echo "### Version 1.0.0" >> docs/changelog.md
          echo "- Initial release" >> docs/changelog.md
          echo "![Logo](assets/logo.png)" > docs/assets/logo.png
          echo ".custom { background-color: #f0f0f0; }" > docs/assets/custom.css

      - name: Build MkDocs site
        run: mkdocs build --clean

      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: peaceiris/actions-gh-pages@v4
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          publish_dir: ./site
```
